notes: 5.52.0's zip reader worked on the owner's 118,513,718-byte archive at the first real attempt: it opened the container, inflated it, and read a clean 112-column header. Then it refused, by name — because that header does not carry date. It carries datekey. The vendor gives one column two names on two delivery paths. The filtered API serves date; the bulk export serves datekey. Everything either side of it is identical — ticker, dimension, calendardate, <it>, reportperiod, fiscalperiod, lastupdated, accoci, assets, … — so this is one schema under two spellings, not two schemas.
